modelHelp.ntd11.title: NTD11
modelHelp.ntd11.text: An optional model that can catch genital regions missed by the primary model. It can also increase processing time and false positives.
modelHelp.sensitive.title: Sensitive
modelHelp.sensitive.text: An optional genital model from a separate model family. Enable it only when the primary model is insufficient.
modelHelp.hand.title: Exclude hands
modelHelp.hand.text: Detects hands and excludes only their overlap with a genital range. Both a hand model and outline extraction model are required.
modelHelp.fluid.title: Detect white-fluid candidates
modelHelp.fluid.text: Detects small white regions inside a genital range as reviewable exclusion candidates. They start disabled. No additional model is required.
modelHelp.handSegmentation.title: HandSegNet anime SDXL
modelHelp.handSegmentation.text: Refines a hand detection range into an image-aligned mask, so hands overlapping genital candidates can be excluded more accurately. Available only when Exclude hands is on.
modelHelp.precision.title: Refine automatic detection outlines
modelHelp.precision.text: This does not detect genitals by itself. It refines already detected ranges with the outline extraction model. The checkpoint must match the selected vit_b, vit_l, or vit_h model type, and is also used by the boundary tool.
modelHelp.samType.title: Outline extraction model type
modelHelp.samType.text: Choose the outline model size. The checkpoint must match the selected vit_b, vit_l, or vit_h model type. Larger models tend to improve accuracy, but need more processing time and VRAM.
